name: CrisisRoom
description: Practise a crisis before it happens. A team-built crisis rehearsal application for nonprofit boards: participants take leadership roles, discuss an unfolding situation, vote on decisions, and review AI-assisted feedback.
facts: Leadership roles and shared crisis scenarios.
Timed speaking, discussion and voting.
Optional recordings, reviewed transcripts and narrated consequences.
A decision history and qualitative AI feedback.
I worked with a team of three, contributing to AI-assisted decision feedback and voice integration.

portfolio.meta: CommuniHacks 2026 · Capacity Canada · with Jeff David Tieng and Ricardo Gao

name: Rhythm
description: Health routines, connected. A health companion bringing movement, meals and useful assistant context into one place. Rhythm combines activity tracking with an experimental camera coach and AI-assisted features.
facts: Meals and activity in a shared calendar.
Exercise tracking and prototype form feedback.
Account-scoped assistant memory.
Saved video content with source links and available transcripts.

name: Dune Rush
description: One track. Five worlds. A browser-based riding game built with 3D Gaussian splats. Switch between five environments while the ride, physics and lap timer continue.
facts: Five environments that can change during a ride.
Gaussian-splat rendering with Spark and Three.js.
PhysX-based collision behaviour.
Lap timing and locally saved personal bests.
Co-developed with Ali. Desktop WebGL2 browser required.
